title: State
description: Whether the machine is running and, when it is not, why. Published on change and retained, so a late subscriber knows the current state.

ts.description: UTC time of the event at the node, RFC 3339 with Z. Omitted while the node clock is not synchronised.

seq.description: Per-node message counter, +1 on every message published, restarts at 0 on boot.

boot.description: Random id drawn at power-up. A new value means counters and seq restarted.

category.description: Only when running is false. closed: plant shut, no demand. unscheduled: no shift programmed. planned: meal, changeover, preventive maintenance. failure: the machine broke. unplanned: any other unplanned stop (no material, no operator).

reason.description: Slug naming the stop or failure mode, e.g. meal, changeover, jam, seal-wear. Optional; set by the operator panel or the PLC.
